items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: My first group was precisely in the Liborio. I had on the piano, Rafael Benitez, Xiomara Alfaro’s husband.

ctx.x: My first group was precisely in the Liborio. I had on the piano, Rafael Benitez, Xiomara Alfaro’s husband. On the bass at first was the Panameño, Alfonso Joseph. Then came Cachao on bass.
How long was Cachao on bass?
